```{r}

library(forecast)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(tseries)

```


```{r}

source("Funciones.R")

```


# simulacion de series

```{r}
# semilla = set.seed(2025)

serie_ARIMA1 <- simular_serie(tipo = "ARIMA", orden = c(2, 1, 2), n = 180,
                               phi = c(0.12, 0.56), theta = c(-0.2, 0.5))


ARIMA2 <-  simular_serie(tipo = "ARIMA", orden = c(1,1,1), n = 250,
                          phi = 0.12, theta = 0.5)

st_ARMA <- simular_serie(tipo = "ARMA", orden = c(1, 1), n = 200, phi =0.81,
                         theta = -0.56)

st_ARI <- simular_serie(tipo = "ARI", orden = c(2, 1), n = 200,
                        phi = c(0.5, -0.1))

```

# Serie ARIMA(2,1,2)

## Exploracion

```{r}

gArima1 <- autoplot(serie_ARIMA1) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.75) +
  labs(title = "Serie Original: ARIMA(2,1,2)", x = "Tiempo", y = "Unidades") +
  theme_minimal()

gArima1

```


```{r}

ggAcf(serie_ARIMA1, lag.max = 24) +
  labs(title = "ACF Serie original ARIMA(2,1,2)") +
  theme_minimal()


```


```{r}

ggPacf(serie_ARIMA1, lag.max = 24) + 
  labs(title = "PACF Serie original ARIMA(2,1,2)") +
  theme_minimal()

```




## ajuste


```{r}

ARIMA1_Aml <- ajustar_serie(serie = serie_ARIMA1, orden = c(2, 1, 2), 
                            metodo = "ML")

```



```{r}

ARIMA1_Acss <- ajustar_serie(serie = serie_ARIMA1, orden = c(2, 1, 2), 
                            metodo = "CSS")

```


```{r}

ARIMA1_Acssml <- ajustar_serie(serie = serie_ARIMA1, orden = c(2, 1, 2), 
                            metodo = "CSS-ML")

```
